title: fix(dispatch-gates): a migration-entry change derives the cli guidance test that reads every entry
body:
Fixes #34760
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`dispatch-gates` 新增一条变更种类行:改动 `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**` 时,派生清单会点名 cli 的 `migrate-meta-engine-guidance` 测试命令。
- 为什么改:该测试检查每条迁移条目打印给作者的文字不带工单号,但只在 CI 的 Test Core 里跑,本地门禁清单全绿也会在 CI 才红,白费一轮。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `scripts/pm/**` 三个文件,不发布、不新增门禁或 CI 作业;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`(新行与根目录常量)、`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`(`ciSubset` 绑定与 STALE 判定)、`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`(新测试段)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-defs/17.api__CreateViewRequest.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -c migrate-meta-engine-guidance`,预期输出 `1`(main 上为 `0`)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Data** (`dispatch-gates.data.mjs`): a new `CHANGE_KIND_ROWS` row, kind `spec-migration-entry`, naming `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`, and `SPEC_MIGRATION_ENTRY_ROOTS` (the `entries` directory and its subtree, in CI's `paths:` language), plus the row's deletion criterion in the table header. The row's `why` states the build prerequisite runnably (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build`): the cli test config does not alias `@objectstack/spec` to source, so a stale spec dist would answer for the edit.
- **Engine** (`dispatch-gates.mjs`): the predicate `readBySpecMigrationEntryConsumers` (the same `triggerListCovers` reader the ui/scripts suite row uses), and one extension of the existing CI-job binding. The ui suite gate narrows its runner by prefix; Test Core's runner (`set -- pnpm turbo run test`) names no package and no file, so this gate declares `ciSubset` (the repo path of the one test file). At load, `bindChangeKindRows` holds the name to the one spelling `packageTestSubsetFile` reads, and that file must match `ciSubset`. At resolve, the gate turns STALE when the Test Core job no longer runs the package test task OR the file is gone, so a moved test cannot leave a command that runs nothing.
- **Self-test**: a new section (specimens, controls, rendering, runnable union, `--ran` verdict without it, STALE rendering, the load-time refusals, and the live binding plus live file plus owning package). The marker-line census pin moves 751 to 753 because of the two import lines.

**One named row, not the general form.** The tree does give a syntactic signal: ten cli test files import `@objectstack/spec/migrations`. But that import is not a reading of the entries' prose. The others drive one conversion, a range or a write, behaviour the spec package's own tests already reach, and one of them is nightly-tier `.e2e`, so the queue never runs it. The guidance test is the only one that holds every entry's printed text, which is what an entry edit changes, and it is the test that was measured missing. A second consumer gets its own row when its own miss is measured. This is written into the `SPEC_MIGRATION_ENTRY_ROOTS` docblock.

No new gate, no new check script, no new CI job and no new `pnpm check:*` (the card's ruling). `scripts/pm/**` ships nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Tests

<details><summary>Re-check (card) and controls, at head 8463c44aae</summary>

- `--commands packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-defs/17.api__CreateViewRequest.ts`: 73 commands, **1** naming `migrate-meta-engine-guidance`. On `origin/main` d947a93cf8 the count was 0 of 72. The card's own path `entries/index.ts` does not exist, so a real file under `entries/` was used.
- CONTROL `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: 0. CONTROL `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`: 0. The `entries` directory itself: 1.
</details>

<details><summary>Self-test</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test --fast`: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2249 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred.`
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier off CI): the same verdict line, plus `✓ check:pm-dispatch-gates --self-test: the exit contract holds…`. The slow tier is NOT MEASURED locally (reason: off-CI default is the fast tier, and the run is longer than the container's foreground cap). CI runs it.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one shot, committed fix first, via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

- Mutation: the predicate binding `'spec-migration-entry': (path) => readBySpecMigrationEntryConsumers(path),` changed to `'spec-migration-entry': () => false,`. The tool reported `anchor 1 -> 0`, and the injected text was counted at 1 on disk.
- Under the mutant: re-check count **0**, and the fast self-test **exited 1** with 10 failing cases. Among them: `through the whole table, …17.api__CreateViewRequest.ts derives the guidance test`, `⭐ a run record carrying every derived command BUT the guidance test is NOT ok, and names it unrun`, and the STALE-rendering case.
- Restore: `blob == HEAD (6c5fd050959f) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
</details>

<details><summary>The derived command runs as written</summary>

`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` under the verify lock: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 3 passed (3)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `--commands` on the parent directory `packages/spec/src/migrations` is deliberately not covered by the roots, because the registry template and generator beside `entries/` are not what the test reads. A surface given as `packages/spec` does not derive the row either.
- While writing the matcher, `check:pnpm-filter-targets` flagged it. The first spelling of the regex and of the refusal text read as two dead `--filter` targets. Both were respelled in 8463c44aae, and the gate is green.

## Verification

All 63 were run locally with exit 0. `check:i18n-coverage` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, cli not built), then exit 0 after its stated build: `OK (14 config(s), 423 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`. The `--ran` reconciliation answered: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `overlap-check`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (origin/main and one open PR sharing the data file merge cleanly). CI families are cited from this PR's check-runs in the report.
